turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation for all air quality monitoring stations. Clip the Voronoi polygons to the bounding box of all stations. Which station has the largest Voronoi cell area (in km²), and which has the smallest? Return both station names and their cell areas rounded to 1 decimal place.
turns.actual_response:
Largest Voronoi cell: Tseung Kwan O, 182.2 km²

Smallest Voronoi cell: Central, 8.7 km²
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

query = text("""
WITH pts AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, coordinate::geometry AS geom
    FROM air_quality_station
    WHERE coordinate IS NOT NULL
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT ST_Envelope(ST_Collect(geom)) AS bbox
    FROM pts
),
vor AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom AS geom
    FROM pts
),
cells AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name_en,
        ST_Area(ST_Transform(ST_Intersection(v.geom, b.bbox), 2326)) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2
    FROM vor v
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    JOIN pts p ON ST_Covers(v.geom, p.geom)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        name_en,
        area_km2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY area_km2 DESC) AS rn_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY area_km2 ASC) AS rn_asc,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS n_cells,
        SUM(area_km2) OVER () AS total_area_km2
    FROM cells
)
SELECT name_en, area_km2, rn_desc, rn_asc, n_cells, total_area_km2
FROM ranked
WHERE rn_desc = 1 OR rn_asc = 1
ORDER BY rn_desc;
""")

vor_summary = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

largest = vor_summary.loc[vor_summary["rn_desc"] == 1].iloc[0]
smallest = vor_summary.loc[vor_summary["rn_asc"] == 1].iloc[0]

largest_cell_station_name = str(largest["name_en"])
largest_cell_area_km2 = round(float(largest["area_km2"]), 1)
smallest_cell_station_name = str(smallest["name_en"])
smallest_cell_area_km2 = round(float(smallest["area_km2"]), 1)

print({
    "cell_count": int(vor_summary["n_cells"].iloc[0]),
    "total_clipped_area_km2": round(float(vor_summary["total_area_km2"].iloc[0]), 1),
    "largest_cell_station_name": largest_cell_station_name,
    "largest_cell_area_km2": largest_cell_area_km2,
    "smallest_cell_station_name": smallest_cell_station_name,
    "smallest_cell_area_km2": smallest_cell_area_km2
})
